# Vendored dependency

`xlsx.full.min.js` is the official SheetJS Community Edition standalone browser build.

- Version: 0.20.3
- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- SHA-256: `cc015130aa8521e7f088f88898eba949ccdcbfb38df0bd129b44b7273c3a6f41`
- License: Apache-2.0 (SheetJS Community Edition)

The file is loaded lazily and locally only when an administrator selects an `.xlsx` file. The ordinary login and directory startup paths do not download or parse it.
